title: First steps with patterns
summary: Five short lessons that introduce one idea at a time, then mix them so you practise recognising which pattern fits.

sections.title: Meet the walkthrough
sections.summary: One lesson, fully guided: read the story, step through the reasoning, answer one prediction.

sections.title: Same move, new rule
sections.summary: Opposite pointers again, then your first window. The walkthroughs are there when you need them.

sections.title: New structures
sections.summary: Read the formal statement first and try a plan on paper, then use the walkthrough to check it.

sections.title: Mixed review
sections.summary: Pattern names are hidden. Decide which pattern fits each problem before you reveal it.
